annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub Network as a lucrative way to earn Bitcoin, directs viewers to register through the link below, and instructs them to pay a $99 membership fee to unlock mining pools and partner features. The solicitation combines a profit-oriented mining-investment promise with a required cryptocurrency payment and encouragement to join, rather than merely describing or criticizing the service.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the video links paid membership and Bitcoin Cash payment to access to mining pools, mining-related materials, and possible mining income. The video presents this paid participation as a way to earn Bitcoin and actively guides viewers through registration and payment.
